decisions.reason: The existing message-305 MODIFY already includes tickets randomly allocated for no or invalid referrals in Small Block winner eligibility and adds the applicable contexts.
The existing message-305 MODIFY already expands the trigger from no referral code to no or invalid referral code; the recipient and reward components remain unchanged.
The existing message-305 MODIFY already replaces the no-referral-only ticket rule with the no-or-invalid-referral rule and adds the INVALID_REFERRAL context.
The existing message-305 MODIFY already updates the About-page referral explanation to include invalid codes and random allocation to an existing NFT holder.
The source specifies referral-validation popup behavior and does not necessarily require an additional FAQ entry or change to the current FAQ attributes.
Referral-validation popup wording and invalid-code handling do not change email delivery, email contents, or notification behavior.
The validation and popup decision does not change the metadata ticket counter, badge visibility, or use of the NFT mint number as the referral-code attribute.
The source concerns validation popup messages and reward routing, not the Mission page's current referral or prize-pool presentation.
The source confirms recipient routing for the existing commission and ticket but does not change the mint price or any primary-mint allocation amount or destination.
The referral-validation popup decision does not change the landing-page hero copy, layout, CTA, or selling-point emphasis.
The source affects primary-mint referral validation and reward routing, not secondary-sale royalties, marketplace controls, or ticket generation from secondary sales.
The source identifies who receives a referral commission and prize ticket, but it does not change how a later prize winner receives or is notified about a prize.
